notes.title: Server-Side Operations & Enhanced Anti-Cheat Measures in Version 1.1.0.3
notes.content:
Hey Raspberry Army!

Version 1.1.0.3 has arrived, and we're thrilled to announce a major update: we've transitioned to server-side operations. This means you can now seamlessly idle the game in the background while enjoying other games! Along with this, we've introduced new server-side anti-cheat measures to address market imbalances caused by the removal of Easy Anti-Cheat. Rest assured, we are diligently working to stabilize the market and anticipate resolving these issues soon.

[b]ALL USERS MUST UPDATE THE GAME TO CONTINUE TO GET DROPS[/b]

- Custom anti-cheat improvements to stop speed hacking and exploits shown to us by the community.
- Drops are now handled by our servers
- Created a server to monitor drops as a way of detecting hackers
- Updated notifications to show you what you received
- Resolved issue where select players were not getting drops
- Loading now will reset your two hour timer but NOT your hours played.
    - Incentivizes the players to idle the game more.

notes.title: Fixed freezing, save progress issue and improved UX
notes.content:
Hey Raspberry Army!

Back with some bug fixes and small UX improvements: 

[list]
[*]Resolved issue where a players game would freeze on or after a drop
[*]Resolved issue where progress was not saving and sometimes resetting after game close
[*]Added the drop table upcoming next to the counter so players know what table is coming up
[*]Added drop table in notification of receiving or missing a drop so players know what table was received or missed
[/list]

notes.title: EAC Removed, Performance enhancements and more
notes.content:
Hello Raspberry Army!

Per our announcement earlier, view it [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3048820/view/4230650600748165141?l=english]here[/url], we have released an update!

[list]
[*]Easy Anti Cheat has been removed
[*]Major performance enhancements which include reducing the build size to under 300 mbs 
[*]Fixed bug where the Drop Counter was getting stuck on initializing and not resetting after a drop
[*]Changed text on counter from "Initializing..." to "Getting loot tables..."
[/list]

We encourage those who left us a negative review regarding EAC to consider reevaluating your review based this latest change.

Thank you for everyones continued support on Raspberry!

Join us on discord at [url=https://discord.gg/getraspberries]https://discord.gg/getraspberries[/url]

notes.title: Performance Optimization Released
notes.content:
Based on user reviews and feedback, we made massive performance improvements which include:
[list]
[*] Decreasing the overall size of the game by 146mb to a total of 307mb. 
[*] Optimized processes within the game to reduce load on the CPU and GPU. 
[*] Improved performance by over 80%.
[/list]
We will continue to optimize and improve as we continue. Thank you for your support Raspberry Army!

Join us on discord at [url=https://discord.gg/getraspberries]https://discord.gg/getraspberries[/url]

notes.title: Drop counter, Login drops, New font etc...
notes.content:
Hello Raspberry Army!

We have a smaller post release announcement.

In this update, we you now have:

[list]
[*]Time until next drop counter
The counter in the top center of your screen is the time until the next drop. We added this so players know when the next drop is as voted on in a poll.

[*]Login drops
Players now receive login drops. Note after receiving your first login drop there is a cooldown period before the next login drop. Chance of item drops is located in the drop schedule.

[*]New font to go with the theme of the game

[*]Continuing to improve performance issues
Raspberry is developed in Unreal Engine and uses Easy Anti Cheat, unlike most other clickers built in Unity. This means Raspberry might use more resources. We initially received reports of high resource usage, which we quickly resolved. We continue to make improvements and optimizations with each patch and will keep you updated.

...and various bug fixes reported to us in Discord or ones we have found on our own.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update and we are continuing to add more features and designs everyday.

Join us on discord at [url= https://discord.gg/getraspberries] https://discord.gg/getraspberries[/url]

notes.title: Huge update: Saving progress, equip skins, drop notifications and more
notes.content:
Hello Raspberry Army!

We are excited to release the first major update after the initial beta test!

In this update, we you now have:

[list]
[*]Ability to set the skin of the in-game raspberry to drops you have collected
Clicking the backpack icon in-game will show you all the items you have collected in a drop. You can view a full list of available items at [url=https://getraspberries.com/database]https://getraspberries.com/database[/url]

[*]Drop notifications
After each drop cycle, as scheduled. You will be show a message if  "You got a new  drop!", or "You did not get a drop this time..". This was designed to help users better understand drops.

[*]New achievements
2 hidden achievements, and 4 achievements related to click goals

[*]Saving click progress
Clicks now save and persistent even after the game has closed

[*]Saving time in game in relation to drops
This now means that you can pickup where you left off after closing the game. For example, if you play the game for 1 hour 30 minutes, close the game and reopen later, you only have to wait 30 minutes to the hit the 2 hour scheduled drop. 

[*]Easter eggs
We have scattered Easter eggs throughout the game. Let us know if you find them in discord!

...and various bug fixes reported to us in Discord or ones we have found on our own.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this update and we are continuing to add more features and designs everyday.

Join us on discord at [url= https://discord.gg/getraspberries] https://discord.gg/getraspberries[/url]
